title: [GNR AP B0 PO][Stability] Acode MCA_HAL_IOSF_BRIDGE_RUN_BUSY_TIMEOUT_E and Punit MCA_DISP_RUN_BUSY_TIMEOUT (GPSB hardhang) during G3 cycling or sandstone
description:
During G3 cycling, during OS load (either in early OS load or shortly after booting) system hits a Fatal Acode MCA causing a kernel panic Issue was reproduced on 2 different GNR_AP B0 1S systems during G3 cycling Failure rate during G3 cycling seems low JF53NOR16BN0304 1S Q4G5 - failed 2/15 G3 cycles JF53NOR07AN0204 1S Q44U - failed 1/16 G3 cycles The core that reports the MCA changes each
